title: Spacing, stroke contrast and geometry
slide_intent: Explain density through concrete letter details because a typeface voice depends on more than its family name.
strategic_value: Tight spacing and low stroke contrast can help preserve Lufthansa’s compact typographic character.
demonstration: Overlaid words, paired letters and highlighted counters compare DLH Helvetica with Helvetica Neue LT. Three notes explain spacing, stroke contrast and geometry.
practical_value: Distinguish spacing changes from changes to stroke weight and letter construction.
